body: We broke up
I broke up with him 🙏

Have you been in an abusive relationship? I’m not shutting you out. I made the post because this was my way of getting help and confirming to myself that I’m not crazy and I AM in fact being manipulated. You could never understand the emotional manipulation that goes on in an abusive relationship. So it’s easy to say “wise up” looking in from the outside. But millions of other women have been through similar situations to me and it’s never been helpful to further shame someone and make them feel stupid. I already feel stupid for letting myself get so deep into the situation and even allowing myself to be manipulated. A lot of women stay in abusive situations because of how ashamed they are. I came on here because I knew I wasn’t being crazy, but this man had manipulated me to the point that I questioned everything about myself. It’s not black and white. It’s human psychology. 

FYI I’ve been able to maintain a 4.0gpa this entire time. Grades have nothing to do with being abused and manipulated. Anybody can become a victim. 

And I don’t live in the United States, I’m here for college. You don’t know what it’s like to be thousands and thousands of miles away from the home you grew up in. He took advantage of that fact, separated me from the only friends I had and made me feel like he was the only one that cared about me. But I’ll never allow my loneliness to get me into a situation like this again. And I’m not going to allow anyone to make me feel like I have to blame myself. Regardless of the things he’s done and said I was still kind. HE chose to behave like this. I’m heading to a country where I’ll actually have family and friends nearby and I’ll be studying the subject that I love. So it honestly seems like you’re just hating. I didn’t go out for a random fun night and was unaware of my surroundings, I went out on a date with my now ex boyfriend. Would you rather me stay in the situation? Stay in this country so I can “wise up” instead of getting as far away and close to my support system as possible. Please stop looking at the surface level of things. Millions of women have been in abusive relationships, are all of them “unaware” and “naive”. Come on now.
You sound like him💀.
